title: Afternoon edge network & capacity todo
content:
Quick afternoon scratchpad before I head out (mix of tasks + reminders). Mostly edge-network and capacity focused.

Context: saw intermittent packet drops in us-west2 edge cluster around 14:22-14:45. GPU reclaim queue length climbed after the flaps, some jobs timed out and retried. Need to stabilize before tomorrow's spike test.

Top priorities (finish before EOD):
- Verify current queue depth and reclaim backlog (estimate 15m)
  - curl http://ops-api.internal/v1/queues/gpu-reclaim | jq .depth  # expect < 30
  - If depth > 50: escalate to Diego, trigger manual drain on noncritical pools
- Reconcile node-level packet loss with network team (10m)
  - Grab latest tc/ethtool logs from node edge-usw2-rack4-12: /var/log/network/tc-*.log
  - Paste last 2 mins of ifconfig output into #edge-net-ops slack thread
- Bump preemption threshold for low-priority batch jobs for next 2 hours (5m)
content_extra:
Temporary workarounds tried (notes):
- Restarted kube-proxy on 3 affected nodes — transient improvement for ~5m, then drops resumed
- Disabled a recently rolled out iptables rule (PR 987) on one node: immediate reduction in retransmits

Follow-ups for tomorrow:
- Schedule controlled iptables rollback across canary group (book 30m with netops)
- Run full capacity sweep at 06:00 PT: simulate 1.2x normal batch + 0.8x real-time to validate autoscale guardrails
- Add a short eval in Redwood Optimize to verify that quantized models on reclaimed nodes don't spike memory (ticket INFRA-5901)

Questions / open concerns (to triage):
- Are we confident the kernel queue limits are tuned for mixed RT and batch workloads on these edge racks? (ping SRE)
- Is KV cache eviction behaving incorrectly during packet loss windows? Observed higher cache miss rate in logs around 14:25

Quick checklist before leaving:
[ ] Post summary to #platform-shift-handoff (include logs + quick commands)
[ ] Add a pinned note to the runbook with the node list I checked
[ ] Create a brief postmortem stub if we see a repeat in the next 24h

Notes-to-self (short):
- If reclaim queue spikes again, temporarily set reclaim_backoff_ms=200 on pool-config edge-preemptable-2
- Keep an eye on tokenized billing for hosts that restarted (weird billing delta last week)

Hand-off to on-call (if still open at shift end):
- Primary: Diego Patel — reach out via Slack then phone if severity >= P1
- Secondary: Lina Gomez — takes network logs and coordinates with netops

End of notes.

-- Samira
